prompt.task_description: You are given GOOGL's 10-Q filing for the quarter ending 2025-09-30. Extract and normalize the following financial metrics from the filing and XBRL data: revenue, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, operating_cash_flow, and operating_margin. Report all monetary values in USD (unscaled). Use only information available as of the filing date (2025-10-30).
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing a 'metrics' key mapping each metric name to its numeric value.
